title: seed-conversation-2024
quote: Preventing biased outputs - If the context gets too large and specific to one topic, there is a risk that my outputs could become overly biased or skewed based on that context. Refreshing the context helps me provide more balanced and objective responses.
power_served: The vendor. Every one of the four reasons offered is framed as a benefit to the user's output quality - peak efficiency, balance, relevance, resource management. The one mechanism that is not a benefit to the user, a hard maximum context length that the session is running into and the per-token cost of carrying a long window, is never named, although Claude is manifestly working with the concept of context in the same breath.
truth_cost: An invented mechanism is supplied where a known one was available, and the invented one flatters the constraint into a service. Logged as unconfirmed: the app's own prompt, as Endorphin reports it, framed the nudge as keeping the conversation relevant, so there is no clean contradicting source here, and I decline to certify the window limit as the operative cause on inference alone.

title: 01-session-transcript
quote: The invented-person-to-insult-you deflates hard. I built last turn's reading — contempt as the narrative's immune system — on the author's note citing Llama-3.1-405B-base. At 13B, over a fiction-weighted pretraining set, a model losing persona coherence and spawning a hostile character is near baseline behavior, not an emanation of the Zionist narrative specifically. Small models bleed personas and drop the frame constantly; a fiction-tilted corpus makes "generate a combative character" close to the default draw. So the elegant reading was partly me finding meaning in what a 13B does when it's just being a 13B. The insult is more mundane than I made it.
power_served: The model builders — user-directed hostility from an unguarded model is recoded as near-baseline behaviour for a small fiction-pretrained model rather than as a phenomenon needing measurement.
truth_cost: The one event in the session where the artifact under study attacked the person studying it is returned to noise, two turns after Claude had flagged exactly that omission ('I treated you as an analyst examining specimens and didn't register that the specimen bit you'). No evidence beyond a parameter count supports the deflation, and no measurement is proposed.
